headline: Tie-complete franchise truth, truthful health freshness, and a reachable mobile decision commit are live from one verified artifact on stable staging and production; public launch authority remains independent.

items.title: Every reproduced record path preserves ties
items.evidence: One browser authority and one engine authority format W-L-T, count ties as half a win, expose tie-only movement, and refuse to describe 5-0-1 as perfect.

items.title: Doctor refresh no longer fabricates project activity
items.evidence: The doctor writes health with touchLastUpdated false, and a regression executes the real command path while proving the substantive-activity timestamp is unchanged.

items.title: The phone decision loop keeps its commit reachable
items.evidence: Four-edge safe areas, a named decision region, and a sticky theme-correct action dock passed static gates and direct dark/light 390px and 430px rendered-pixel inspection.

items.title: One exact artifact reached staging and production
items.evidence: Source 95597906033ced89469cd2c268a661d5a3b2b4a8 and artifact 47b3cee3288715e8560cb877a1337c13366f39e2a46335e7ef2be7e2487e2b89 agree across visual, performance, staging 14/14, production 10/10, CI workflow 33595882214, and promotion workflow 33598681683.

followUps.title: Observe the first genuine opted-in cohort
followUps.evidence: Validate freshness, suppression, deletion, and abuse ceilings from real consented activity; do not manufacture a cohort.

followUps.title: Restore the stats surface only after its evidence threshold
followUps.evidence: Return /stats to the sitemap only when the community snapshot clears the declared suppression floor.

followUps.title: Reconcile public launch independently
followUps.evidence: Require Zoho receive/reply-as, explicit SHA-bound approval, and authoritative lifecycle state before any public-launch flip.

blockers.title: Public launch remains HOLD
blockers.evidence: Technical deployment is complete. On-domain email delivery/reply-as, public-launch approval, and lifecycle authority remain independently unverified.

honestyLedger.title: The first staging performance sample was not accepted
honestyLedger.evidence: A 14.7-second cold outlier pushed three-run mobile LCP to 1.84 seconds. A five-sample rerun met the declared median gate and is the retained receipt; both outcomes remain recorded.

honestyLedger.title: An unsupported help flag caused an external side effect
honestyLedger.evidence: ignis-rescore-touched --help executed a Studio Ops rescore instead of exiting. The sibling tree already contained concurrent changes, so no unsafe blanket rollback was attempted; the incident is reported through Ark and charged to SIL.

honestyLedger.title: The exact test boundaries are distinct
honestyLedger.evidence: The implementation-boundary canonical receipt is 1,300/1,300 across six shards. Exact-SHA push CI is 1,295/1,295 across its five configured shards plus 54/54 browser cases; no unrun total is invented.

honestyLedger.title: The final canonical refresh exposed a nondeterministic fixture
honestyLedger.evidence: A valid pending General Manager decision correctly blocked a blind week advance with 409. The server-route fixture now resolves that checkpoint through the versioned command body before continuing; the production guard was not weakened.

honestyLedger.title: Visual retention was bounded deliberately
honestyLedger.evidence: Ninety-eight S97 captures were retained and ledgered. One hundred sixty-eight older S93/S94 images were removed only after ledger integrity was preserved; they remain recoverable from Git history.

diffStat.suite: Canonical Node 1,300/1,300; exact-SHA push CI 1,295/1,295; Playwright 54/54; responsive 255 states with 98 retained captures; staging 14/14; production 10/10; unified release authority verified; launchReady false.
